tools.name: assessment_questions
tools.description: Use when someone wants to check where their organisation stands with data protection. The questions of EasyLPD's self-assessment that apply to an organisation's profile, each with its id, area, why it matters, its weight and the legal references. Ask them in the conversation, a few at a time, answer

tools.name: score_assessment
tools.description: Use after the questions of assessment_questions have been answered. Scores them per applicable law, with the risk level and the three gaps to start from, and returns openInEasyLPD: a link that shows the same result in EasyLPD, to give to the user. Guidance, not legal advice or a certification.

tools.name: transfer_check
tools.description: Use when someone asks whether they may use a provider or send personal data to another country (cloud, hosting, CRM, US services). Whether sending personal data to a country is allowed without further safeguards under the Swiss FADP and under the EU GDPR (adequacy lists), by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 count
